<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="zh-CN">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8" />
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0, viewport-fit=cover" />
<meta name="theme-color" content="rgb(3,8,14)" />
<link rel="icon" href="data:,">
<title>行星发动机 · 3D 拆解监控台</title>
<style>
  :root {
    --bg: #02060b;
    --bg-2: #06111c;
    --panel: rgba(5, 13, 21, 0.82);
    --panel-2: rgba(9, 20, 31, 0.72);
    --line: rgba(126, 196, 235, 0.16);
    --line-strong: rgba(143, 224, 255, 0.42);
    --text: #dcebf6;
    --text-2: #8da6ba;
    --text-3: #536b7f;
    --cyan: #7adfff;
    --cyan-bright: #d3f8ff;
    --white: #f4fbff;
    --amber: #ffb264;
    --amber-soft: #ffd5a8;
    --danger: #ff7162;
    --danger-soft: #ffb8ad;
    --ok: #7cffd5;
    --font-display: "Bahnschrift", "DIN Alternate", "Segoe UI", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif;
    --font-ui: "Segoe UI", "Microsoft YaHei", "PingFang SC", "Noto Sans CJK SC", sans-serif;
    --font-mono: "Consolas", "SFMono-Regular", "Roboto Mono", "Courier New", monospace;
    --shadow: 0 28px 90px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.55);
    --ease: cubic-bezier(0.22, 0.61, 0.36, 1);
  }

  * { box-sizing: border-box; }
  html, body { width: 100%; height: 100%; margin: 0; overflow: hidden; }
  body {
    background:
      radial-gradient(ellipse at 54% 38%, rgba(17, 48, 76, 0.38), transparent 52%),
      radial-gradient(ellipse at 50% 100%, rgba(8, 26, 42, 0.5), transparent 58%),
      var(--bg);
    color: var(--text);
    font-family: var(--font-ui);
    -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
    user-select: none;
  }
  button { font: inherit; color: inherit; }
  button:focus-visible {
    outline: 1px solid var(--cyan);
    outline-offset: 3px;
  }

  #scene {
    position: fixed;
    inset: 0;
    width: 100%;
    height: 100%;
    display: block;
    touch-action: none;
    cursor: grab;
  }
  #scene:active { cursor: grabbing; }

  .hud-overlay {
    position: fixed;
    inset: 0;
    z-index: 6;
    pointer-events: none;
  }
  .scanlines {
    position: absolute;
    inset: 0;
    opacity: 0.5;
    background: repeating-linear-gradient(
      to bottom,
      rgba(255, 255, 255, 0) 0px,
      rgba(255, 255, 255, 0) 3px,
      rgba(115, 196, 235, 0.022) 4px
    );
    mix-blend-mode: soft-light;
  }
  .vignette {
    position: absolute;
    inset: 0;
    background:
      radial-gradient(ellipse at center, transparent 38%, rgba(0, 4, 8, 0.52) 100%),
      linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(0, 4, 8, 0.34), transparent 18%, transparent 80%, rgba(0, 4, 8, 0.58));
  }
  .hud-grid {
    position: absolute;
    inset: 0;
    opacity: 0.18;
    background-image:
      linear-gradient(rgba(120, 200, 235, 0.05) 1px, transparent 1px),
      linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(120, 200, 235, 0.05) 1px, transparent 1px);
    background-size: 120px 120px;
    mask-image: radial-gradient(ellipse at center, black 20%, transparent 76%);
  }
  .ignition-flash {
    position: fixed;
    inset: 0;
    z-index: 7;
    pointer-events: none;
    opacity: 0;
    background:
      radial-gradient(ellipse 28% 48% at 50% 26%, rgba(230, 251, 255, 0.9), rgba(88, 200, 255, 0.22) 38%, transparent 72%);
    mix-blend-mode: screen;
    transition: opacity 1.5s ease-out;
  }
  .ignition-flash.on { opacity: 0.7; transition-duration: 0.18s; }

  /* ---------- top bar ---------- */
  .topbar {
    position: fixed;
    top: 0;
    left: 0;
    right: 0;
    z-index: 40;
    height: 84px;
    padding: 0 clamp(16px, 2.4vw, 40px);
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: 1fr auto 1fr;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 20px;
    background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(2, 7, 12, 0.94) 0%, rgba(2, 7, 12, 0.48) 62%, transparent 100%);
    pointer-events: none;
  }
  .brand {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 13px;
    min-width: 0;
    pointer-events: auto;
  }
  .brand-mark {
    width: 40px;
    height: 40px;
    flex: 0 0 auto;
    filter: drop-shadow(0 0 8px rgba(90, 200, 255, 0.28));
  }
  .brand-mark .spin { transform-origin: 24px 24px; animation: spin 24s linear infinite; }
  .brand-mark .bm-line { stroke: var(--cyan); }
  .brand-mark .bm-bright { stroke: var(--cyan-bright); }
  .brand-mark .bm-core { fill: var(--white); }
  .brand-text { min-width: 0; }
  .brand-title {
    font-family: var(--font-display);
    font-size: 15px;
    font-weight: 600;
    letter-spacing: 0.18em;
    color: var(--white);
    line-height: 1.15;
    white-space: nowrap;
  }
  .brand-sub {
    margin-top: 5px;
    font-family: var(--font-mono);
    font-size: 9px;
    letter-spacing: 0.14em;
    color: var(--text-3);
    white-space: nowrap;
  }
  .brand-sub b { color: var(--cyan); font-weight: 500; }
  .status-cluster {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 7px;
    pointer-events: auto;
  }
  .status-row { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; }
  .state-chip {
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 9px;
    min-height: 30px;
    padding: 0 13px;
    border: 1px solid rgba(255, 178, 100, 0.26);
    background: rgba(255, 178, 100, 0.055);
    color: var(--amber-soft);
    font-family: var(--font-mono);
    font-size: 10px;
    letter-spacing: 0.12em;
    clip-path: polygon(7px 0, 100% 0, 100% calc(100% - 7px), calc(100% - 7px) 100%, 0 100%, 0 7px);
    transition: all 0.4s var(--ease);
  }
  .state-chip .dot {
    width: 6px;
    height: 6px;
    border-radius: 50%;
    background: var(--amber);
    box-shadow: 0 0 10px var(--amber);
    animation: blink 2.4s ease-in-out infinite;
  }
  .state-chip.online { border-color: rgba(122, 223, 255, 0.45); background: rgba(80, 190, 235, 0.09); color: var(--cyan-bright); }
  .state-chip.online .dot { background: var(--cyan); box-shadow: 0 0 12px var(--cyan); animation-duration: 1s; }
  .state-chip.warn { border-color: rgba(255, 113, 98, 0.4); background: rgba(255, 113, 98, 0.07); color: var(--danger-soft); }
  .state-chip.warn .dot { background: var(--danger); box-shadow: 0 0 10px var(--danger); }
  .struct-chip {
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 8px;
    font-family: var(--font-mono);
    font-size: 9px;
    letter-spacing: 0.1em;
    color: var(--text-3);
  }
  .struct-chip strong { color: var(--text-2); font-weight: 500; }
  .struct-chip i {
    width: 16px;
    height: 1px;
    background: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, var(--line-strong));
    display: inline-block;
  }
  .guide {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 12px;
    font-size: 10px;
    color: var(--text-3);
    letter-spacing: 0.04em;
  }
  .guide span { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 5px; white-space: nowrap; }
  .guide kbd {
    font-family: var(--font-mono);
    font-size: 8px;
    padding: 2px 5px;
    border: 1px solid var(--line);
    color: var(--text-2);
    background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.03);
  }
  .top-metrics {
    justify-self: end;
    display: flex;
    align-items: stretch;
    gap: 0;
    pointer-events: auto;
  }
  .metric {
    min-width: 92px;
    padding: 0 14px;
    border-left: 1px solid var(--line);
    text-align: right;
  }
  .metric:first-child { border-left: 0; }
  .metric label {
    display: block;
    font-family: var(--font-mono);
    font-size: 8px;
    color: var(--text-3);
    letter-spacing: 0.14em;
    margin-bottom: 5px;
  }
  .metric b {
    display: block;
    font-family: var(--font-mono);
    font-size: 11px;
    font-weight: 500;
    color: var(--text-2);
    letter-spacing: 0.04em;
    white-space: nowrap;
  }
  .metric b.hot { color: var(--cyan-bright); text-shadow: 0 0 12px rgba(100, 220, 255, 0.5); }

  /* ---------- side panels ---------- */
  .panel {
    position: fixed;
    top: 96px;
    bottom: 128px;
    z-index: 32;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    width: clamp(252px, 18vw, 304px);
    background:
      linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(10, 22, 34, 0.82), rgba(4, 11, 18, 0.78)),
      repeating-linear-gradient(0deg, transparent 0 39px, rgba(120, 195, 235, 0.022) 40px);
    border: 1px solid var(--line);
    box-shadow: var(--shadow), inset 0 1px 0 rgba(190, 235, 255, 0.045);
    backdrop-filter: blur(16px) saturate(118%);
    -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(16px) saturate(118%);
    clip-path: polygon(0 0, calc(100% - 16px) 0, 100% 16px, 100% 100%, 16px 100%, 0 calc(100% - 16px));
    transition: transform 0.45s var(--ease), opacity 0.35s ease;
  }
  .left-panel { left: clamp(16px, 2.2vw, 34px); }
  .right-panel { right: clamp(16px, 2.2vw, 34px); width: clamp(298px, 21vw, 366px); }
  .panel::after {
    content: "";
    position: absolute;
    left: 18px;
    right: 18px;
    top: 0;
    height: 1px;
    background: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, rgba(135, 224, 255, 0.48), transparent);
    pointer-events: none;
  }
  .panel-head {
    padding: 18px 18px 15px;
    border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line);
    flex: 0 0 auto;
  }
  .panel-kicker {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: space-between;
    gap: 10px;
    font-family: var(--font-mono);
    font-size: 8px;
    letter-spacing: 0.16em;
    color: var(--text-3);
    margin-bottom: 8px;
  }
  .panel-kicker .live { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; color: var(--cyan); }
  .panel-kicker .live i {
    width: 5px; height: 5px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--cyan);
    box-shadow: 0 0 8px rgba(122, 223, 255, 0.8); animation: blink 1.8s infinite;
  }
  .panel-title {
    display: flex;
    align-items: baseline;
    justify-content: space-between;
    gap: 8px;
  }
  .panel-title h1 {
    margin: 0;
    font-family: var(--font-display);
    font-size: 20px;
    font-weight: 500;
    letter-spacing: 0.08em;
    color: var(--white);
  }
  .panel-title .count {
    font-family: var(--font-mono);
    font-size: 9px;
    color: var(--cyan);
    letter-spacing: 0.1em;
  }
  .panel-sub {
    margin-top: 7px;
    display: flex;
    justify-content: space-between;
    font-family: var(--font-mono);
    font-size: 8px;
    color: var(--text-3);
    letter-spacing: 0.12em;
  }
  .part-list {
    flex: 1 1 auto;
    min-height: 0;
    overflow-y: auto;
    overscroll-behavior: contain;
    padding: 4px 0;
    scrollbar-width: thin;
    scrollbar-color: rgba(122, 223, 255, 0.24) transparent;
  }
  .part-list::-webkit-scrollbar { width: 4px; }
  .part-list::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb { background: rgba(122, 223, 255, 0.22); }
  .part-row {
    position: relative;
    width: 100%;
    min-height: 55px;
    padding: 9px 15px 9px 14px;
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: 27px 1fr auto;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 9px;
    background: transparent;
    border: 0;
    border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(126, 196, 235, 0.075);
    text-align: left;
    cursor: pointer;
    transition: background 0.24s ease;
  }
  .part-row::before {
    content: "";
    position: absolute;
    left: 0;
    top: 10px;
    bottom: 10px;
    width: 2px;
    background: transparent;
    box-shadow: 0 0 12px transparent;
    transition: all 0.24s ease;
  }
  .part-row:hover { background: rgba(104, 190, 232, 0.055); }
  .part-row.is-active {
    background: linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(63, 166, 214, 0.16), rgba(63, 166, 214, 0.015) 72%, transparent);
  }
  .part-row.is-active::before { background: var(--cyan); box-shadow: 0 0 14px rgba(122, 223, 255, 0.7); }
  .part-row .idx {
    font-family: var(--font-mono);
    font-size: 9px;
    color: var(--text-3);
    letter-spacing: 0.08em;
    transition: color 0.24s ease;
  }
  .part-row.is-active .idx { color: var(--cyan); }
  .p-main { min-width: 0; }
  .p-name {
    display: block;
    font-size: 12.5px;
    line-height: 1.25;
    color: var(--text-2);
    letter-spacing: 0.03em;
    white-space: nowrap;
    overflow: hidden;
    text-overflow: ellipsis;
    transition: color 0.24s ease;
  }
  .part-row:hover .p-name, .part-row.is-active .p-name { color: var(--white); }
  .p-en {
    display: block;
    margin-top: 4px;
    font-family: var(--font-mono);
    font-size: 7.5px;
    color: var(--text-3);
    letter-spacing: 0.13em;
    white-space: nowrap;
    overflow: hidden;
    text-overflow: ellipsis;
  }
  .p-state {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: flex-end;
    gap: 5px;
    font-family: var(--font-mono);
    font-size: 7px;
    letter-spacing: 0.08em;
    color: var(--text-3);
  }
  .p-state i {
    width: 13px;
    height: 2px;
    background: rgba(126, 196, 235, 0.22);
    transition: background 0.3s ease, box-shadow 0.3s ease, width 0.3s ease;
  }
  .part-row.is-open .p-state { color: var(--cyan); }
  .part-row.is-open .p-state i { width: 21px; background: var(--cyan); box-shadow: 0 0 9px rgba(122, 223, 255, 0.8); }
  .panel-foot {
    flex: 0 0 auto;
    padding: 12px 17px 14px;
    border-top: 1px solid var(--line);
    font-family: var(--font-mono);
    font-size: 8px;
    color: var(--text-3);
    letter-spacing: 0.1em;
    line-height: 1.7;
  }
  .panel-foot .bar {
    height: 2px;
    margin-top: 8px;
    background: rgba(126, 196, 235, 0.1);
    overflow: hidden;
  }
  .panel-foot .bar i {
    display: block;
    height: 100%;
    width: 0%;
    background: linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(122, 223, 255, 0.45), var(--cyan));
    box-shadow: 0 0 10px rgba(122, 223, 255, 0.6);
    transition: width 0.5s var(--ease);
  }
  .panel-foot .foot-row { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; gap: 8px; }
  .panel-foot .foot-row b { color: var(--text-2); font-weight: 500; }

  /* ---------- right inspector ---------- */
  .inspector {
    flex: 1 1 auto;
    min-height: 0;
    overflow-y: auto;
    overscroll-behavior: contain;
    padding: 18px 19px 22px;
    scrollbar-width: thin;
    scrollbar-color: rgba(122, 223, 255, 0.22) transparent;
  }
  .inspector::-webkit-scrollbar { width: 4px; }
  .inspector::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb { background: rgba(122, 223, 255, 0.2); }
  .inspector-head {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: space-between;
    gap: 12px;
    margin-bottom: 14px;
  }
  .inspector-kicker {
    font-family: var(--font-mono);
    font-size: 8px;
    letter-spacing: 0.16em;
    color: var(--text-3);
  }
  .code-badge {
    font-family: var(--font-mono);
    font-size: 8.5px;
    letter-spacing: 0.12em;
    color: var(--cyan);
    border: 1px solid rgba(122, 223, 255, 0.26);
    background: rgba(122, 223, 255, 0.055);
    padding: 4px 7px;
  }
  .live-flag {
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 6px;
    font-family: var(--font-mono);
    font-size: 8px;
    letter-spacing: 0.1em;
    color: var(--ok);
  }
  .live-flag i {
    width: 5px; height: 5px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--ok);
    box-shadow: 0 0 8px rgba(124, 255, 213, 0.75); animation: blink 1.5s infinite;
  }
  .inspector h2 {
    margin: 0;
    font-family: var(--font-display);
    font-size: clamp(24px, 2vw, 31px);
    line-height: 1.14;
    letter-spacing: 0.04em;
    font-weight: 500;
    color: var(--white);
  }
  .en-name {
    margin-top: 7px;
    font-family: var(--font-mono);
    font-size: 9px;
    letter-spacing: 0.19em;
    color: var(--cyan);
    text-transform: uppercase;
  }
  .role-line {
    margin-top: 14px;
    padding: 8px 0;
    border-top: 1px solid var(--line);
    border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line);
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: space-between;
    gap: 10px;
    font-family: var(--font-mono);
    font-size: 8px;
    letter-spacing: 0.1em;
    color: var(--text-3);
  }
  .role-line em {
    font-family: var(--font-ui);
    font-size: 10px;
    font-style: normal;
    color: var(--text);
    letter-spacing: 0.06em;
  }
  .desc {
    margin: 14px 0 0;
    font-size: 12px;
    line-height: 1.75;
    color: var(--text-2);
  }
  .section-title {
    margin-top: 20px;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: space-between;
    gap: 10px;
    font-size: 11px;
    color: var(--text);
    letter-spacing: 0.06em;
  }
  .section-title span {
    font-family: var(--font-mono);
    font-size: 7px;
    letter-spacing: 0.15em;
    color: var(--text-3);
  }
  .section-title::before {
    content: "";
    width: 3px;
    height: 10px;
    margin-right: 8px;
    background: var(--cyan);
    box-shadow: 0 0 9px rgba(122, 223, 255, 0.6);
  }
  .section-title > .st-label { margin-right: auto; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; }
  .section-title > .st-label::before { display: none; }
  .spec-table { margin-top: 9px; border-top: 1px solid var(--line); }
  .spec-row {
    display: flex;
    align-items: baseline;
    justify-content: space-between;
    gap: 12px;
    padding: 9px 0;
    border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(126, 196, 235, 0.08);
  }
  .spec-row dt { margin: 0; font-size: 10px; color: var(--text-3); letter-spacing: 0.04em; }
  .spec-row dd { margin: 0; font-family: var(--font-mono); font-size: 10px; color: var(--text); text-align: right; }
  .metrics { margin-top: 10px; display: grid; gap: 11px; }
  .metric-row .mr-top {
    display: flex;
    justify-content: space-between;
    gap: 10px;
    margin-bottom: 5px;
    font-family: var(--font-mono);
    font-size: 8px;
    letter-spacing: 0.08em;
    color: var(--text-3);
  }
  .metric-row .mr-top b { color: var(--text-2); font-weight: 500; }
  .metric-track { height: 2px; background: rgba(126, 196, 235, 0.1); overflow: hidden; }
  .metric-fill {
    display: block;
    height: 100%;
    width: 0;
    background: linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(85, 186, 226, 0.5), var(--cyan-bright));
    box-shadow: 0 0 9px rgba(122, 223, 255, 0.55);
    transition: width 0.8s var(--ease);
  }
  .inspector-actions {
    display: flex;
    gap: 8px;
    margin-top: 20px;
  }
  .action-small {
    flex: 1;
    min-height: 36px;
    padding: 0 10px;
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    gap: 7px;
    background: rgba(122, 223, 255, 0.05);
    border: 1px solid var(--line);
    color: var(--text-2);
    font-family: var(--font-mono);
    font-size: 8px;
    letter-spacing: 0.08em;
    cursor: pointer;
    transition: all 0.24s ease;
    clip-path: polygon(5px 0, 100% 0, 100% calc(100% - 5px), calc(100% - 5px) 100%, 0 100%, 0 5px);
  }
  .action-small:hover { color: var(--cyan-bright); border-color: rgba(122, 223, 255, 0.42); background: rgba(122, 223, 255, 0.1); }
  .action-small svg { width: 12px; height: 12px; }

  .overview-schematic {
    height: 148px;
    margin: 2px 0 16px;
    position: relative;
    overflow: hidden;
    border-top: 1px solid var(--line);
    border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line);
    background:
      radial-gradient(circle at 50% 50%, rgba(86, 188, 235, 0.08), transparent 56%),
      linear-gradient(rgba(122, 223, 255, 0.035) 1px, transparent 1px),
      linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(122, 223, 255, 0.035) 1px, transparent 1px);
    background-size: auto, 22px 22px, 22px 22px;
  }
  .overview-schematic svg { width: 100%; height: 100%; display: block; }
  .overview-schematic .rotor { transform-origin: 100px 74px; animation: spin 30s linear infinite; }
  .overview-schematic .rotor-rev { transform-origin: 100px 74px; animation: spin 20s linear infinite reverse; }
  .overview-schematic .sch-soft { stroke: var(--cyan); }
  .overview-schematic .sch-cyan { stroke: var(--cyan); }
  .overview-schematic .sch-hull { stroke: var(--cyan-bright); }
  .overview-schematic .sch-core { fill: var(--white); }
  .overview-schematic .sch-txt { fill: var(--text-3); font-family: var(--font-mono); letter-spacing: 1px; }
  .overview-schematic .sch-g0 { stop-color: var(--cyan-bright); }

function makeJupiterTexture() {
  const S = 640;
  const cv = document.createElement('canvas');
  cv.width = cv.height = S;
  const ctx = cv.getContext('2d');
  ctx.clearRect(0, 0, S, S);
  ctx.save();
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(S / 2, S / 2, S * 0.486, 0, TAU);
  ctx.clip();

  const base = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, S);
  base.addColorStop(0, 'rgb(67,50,35)');
  base.addColorStop(0.35, 'rgb(109,81,56)');
  base.addColorStop(0.62, 'rgb(125,92,64)');
  base.addColorStop(1, 'rgb(51,37,27)');
  ctx.fillStyle = base;
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, S, S);

  const bands = ['rgb(85,64,45)', 'rgb(142,107,75)', 'rgb(96,69,47)', 'rgb(163,126,88)', 'rgb(59,44,32)', 'rgb(182,145,106)', 'rgb(119,86,59)'];
  let y = 4;
  while (y < S + 20) {
    const h = 5 + Math.random() * 15;
    ctx.globalAlpha = 0.3 + Math.random() * 0.34;
    ctx.fillStyle = bands[(Math.random() * bands.length) | 0];
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.ellipse(S / 2, y, S * 0.56, h, 0, 0, TAU);
    ctx.fill();
    y += h * 0.72;
  }
  for (let i = 0; i < 80; i++) {
    ctx.globalAlpha = 0.05 + Math.random() * 0.09;
    ctx.fillStyle = Math.random() > 0.5 ? 'rgb(32,22,15)' : 'rgb(214,180,140)';
    const yy = Math.random() * S;
    ctx.fillRect(0, yy, S, 0.7 + Math.random() * 1.8);
  }

  ctx.lineCap = 'round';
  for (let i = 0; i < 30; i++) {
    ctx.globalAlpha = 0.1 + Math.random() * 0.14;
    ctx.strokeStyle = Math.random() > 0.45 ? 'rgb(220,188,146)' : 'rgb(42,31,22)';
    ctx.lineWidth = 1.5 + Math.random() * 7;
    const yy = 24 + Math.random() * (S - 48);
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(-10, yy);
    ctx.bezierCurveTo(S * 0.3, yy + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 24, S * 0.7, yy + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 24, S + 10, yy + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 12);
    ctx.stroke();
  }

  ctx.globalAlpha = 0.36;
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgb(198,138,88)';
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.ellipse(S * 0.6, S * 0.6, 66, 31, -0.16, 0, TAU);
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.globalAlpha = 0.22;
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgb(242,206,166)';
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.ellipse(S * 0.6, S * 0.595, 36, 14, -0.16, 0, TAU);
  ctx.fill();

  ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
  const limb = ctx.createRadialGradient(S / 2, S / 2, S * 0.22, S / 2, S / 2, S * 0.49);
  limb.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(0,0,0,0)');
  limb.addColorStop(0.72, 'rgba(2,6,12,0.3)');
  limb.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(2,6,12,0.98)');
  ctx.fillStyle = limb;
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, S, S);

  const term = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, S, S, 0);
  term.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(0,0,0,0.78)');
  term.addColorStop(0.52, 'rgba(0,0,0,0.2)');
  term.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(0,0,0,0)');
  ctx.fillStyle = term;
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, S, S);

  ctx.globalAlpha = 0.2;
  ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgb(226,240,248)';
  ctx.lineWidth = 5;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(S / 2, S / 2, S * 0.472, -1.15, 0.55);
  ctx.stroke();
  ctx.restore();

  const tex = new THREE.CanvasTexture(cv);
  tex.colorSpace = THREE.SRGBColorSpace;
  tex.anisotropy = 4;
  return tex;
}

function updateBackdrop(dt) {
  backdropTime += dt;
  const arr = snowGeo.attributes.position.array;
  for (let i = 0; i < SNOW_COUNT; i++) {
    const p = snowMeta[i];
    p.y -= p.vy * dt;
    p.phase += p.speed * dt;
    if (ignition > 0.02 && p.y < 34) {
      const rr = Math.hypot(p.x, p.z) + 0.001;
      p.x += (p.x / rr) * ignition * dt * 5.2;
      p.z += (p.z / rr) * ignition * dt * 5.2;
      p.y += ignition * dt * 1.15;
    }
    if (p.y < 0.15 || Math.hypot(p.x, p.z) > 132) {
      p.y = 56 + Math.random() * 10;
      p.x = (Math.random() * 2 - 1) * 92;
      p.z = (Math.random() * 2 - 1) * 92;
    }
    arr[i * 3] = p.x + Math.sin(p.phase) * p.sway;
    arr[i * 3 + 1] = p.y;
    arr[i * 3 + 2] = p.z + Math.cos(p.phase * 0.73) * p.sway * 0.7;
  }
  snowGeo.attributes.position.needsUpdate = true;
  haze.material.opacity = 0.072 + Math.sin(backdropTime * 0.35) * 0.012;
  nebula.position.x = -28 + Math.sin(backdropTime * 0.05) * 7;

function metaOf(id) {

function createModule(id) {
  const meta = metaOf(id);
  const group = new THREE.Group();
  group.name = 'module-' + id;
  scene.add(group);
  const instance = {
    id,
    meta,
    group,
    progress: 0,
    target: 0,
    delay: 0,
    parts: [],
    meshes: [],
    anchor: null
  };
  modules.set(id, instance);
  return instance;
}

function finalizeModule(id) {
  const inst = modules.get(id);
  if (!inst) return;
  inst.group.children.forEach((child) => {
    child.userData.basePos = child.position.clone();
    const radial = V3(child.position.x, 0, child.position.z);
    child.userData.radialDir = radial.lengthSq() > 0.0001 ? radial.normalize() : V3(0, 0, 0);
    inst.parts.push(child);
  });
  inst.group.traverse((obj) => {
    if (obj.isMesh) {
      obj.userData.moduleId = id;
      inst.meshes.push(obj);
      interactiveMeshes.push(obj);
      const mats = Array.isArray(obj.material) ? obj.material : [obj.material];
      mats.forEach((mat) => {
        if (mat && (mat.isMeshStandardMaterial || mat.isMeshPhysicalMaterial || mat.isMeshBasicMaterial)) {
          structuralMaterials.add(mat);
        }
      });
    }
  });
  const anchor = new THREE.Object3D();
  anchor.position.fromArray(inst.meta.anchor);
  inst.group.add(anchor);
  inst.anchor = anchor;
}

function addMesh(parent, geo, mat, x = 0, y = 0, z = 0, rx = 0, ry = 0, rz = 0) {
  const mesh = new THREE.Mesh(geo, mat);
  mesh.position.set(x, y, z);
  mesh.rotation.set(rx, ry, rz);
  parent.add(mesh);
  return mesh;
}

function cyl(parent, rTop, rBottom, height, mat, x = 0, y = 0, z = 0, radialSegments = 24, open = false) {
  return addMesh(parent, new THREE.CylinderGeometry(rTop, rBottom, height, radialSegments, 1, open), mat, x, y, z);
}

function box(parent, w, h, d, mat, x = 0, y = 0, z = 0, ry = 0, rx = 0, rz = 0) {
  return addMesh(parent, new THREE.BoxGeometry(w, h, d), mat, x, y, z, rx, ry, rz);
}

function torus(parent, radius, tube, mat, x = 0, y = 0, z = 0, rotX = Math.PI / 2, radialSegments = 8, tubularSegments = 96) {
  return addMesh(parent, new THREE.TorusGeometry(radius, tube, radialSegments, tubularSegments), mat, x, y, z, rotX);
}

function beam(parent, a, b, radius, mat, radialSegments = 7) {
  const dir = V3().subVectors(b, a);
  const length = dir.length();
  if (length < 0.0001) return null;
  const geo = new THREE.CylinderGeometry(radius, radius, length, radialSegments, 1);
  const mesh = new THREE.Mesh(geo, mat);
  mesh.position.copy(a).add(b).multiplyScalar(0.5);
  mesh.quaternion.setFromUnitVectors(V3(0, 1, 0), dir.normalize());
  parent.add(mesh);
  return mesh;
}

function taperedBeam(parent, a, b, r1, r2, mat, radialSegments = 8) {
  const dir = V3().subVectors(b, a);
  const length = dir.length();
  if (length < 0.0001) return null;
  const geo = new THREE.CylinderGeometry(r2, r1, length, radialSegments, 1);
  const mesh = new THREE.Mesh(geo, mat);
  mesh.position.copy(a).add(b).multiplyScalar(0.5);
  mesh.quaternion.setFromUnitVectors(V3(0, 1, 0), dir.normalize());
  parent.add(mesh);
  return mesh;
}

function wedgePanel(parent, rTop, rBottom, height, y, thetaStart, thetaLength, mat, segments = 10) {
  const geo = new THREE.CylinderGeometry(rTop, rBottom, height, segments, 1, true, thetaStart, thetaLength);
  geo.computeBoundingBox();
  const c = V3();
  geo.boundingBox.getCenter(c);
  geo.translate(-c.x, 0, -c.z);
  const mesh = new THREE.Mesh(geo, mat);
  mesh.position.set(c.x, y, c.z);
  parent.add(mesh);
  return mesh;
}

function radialPoint(angle, radius, y) {
  return V3(Math.cos(angle) * radius, y, Math.sin(angle) * radius);
}

function radialRotation(angle) {
  return Math.PI / 2 - angle;
}

function edgeRib(parent, angle, rBottom, rTop, y0, y1, radius = 0.1, mat = MAT.steel) {
  const a = radialPoint(angle, rBottom * 1.008, y0);
  const b = radialPoint(angle, rTop * 1.008, y1);
  return beam(parent, a, b, radius, mat, 6);
}

function boltRing(parent, radius, y, count, mat = MAT.steel, size = 0.13, height = 0.16) {
  for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
    const a = i / count * TAU;
    cyl(parent, size, size, height, mat, Math.cos(a) * radius, y, Math.sin(a) * radius, 6);
  }
}

function buildTruss() {
  const inst = createModule('truss');
  const g = inst.group;

  torus(g, 10.95, 0.2, MAT.dark, 0, 3.15, 0);
  torus(g, 10.25, 0.14, MAT.hullMid, 0, 5.9, 0);
  torus(g, 9.72, 0.13, MAT.steel, 0, 9.15, 0);
  torus(g, 9.05, 0.19, MAT.hullDark, 0, 12.7, 0);
  torus(g, 9.2, 0.04, MAT.glowSoft, 0, 9.16, 0);

  for (let i = 0; i < 8; i++) {
    const a = i / 8 * TAU + TAU / 16;
    const tangent = V3(-Math.sin(a), 0, Math.cos(a));
    const baseR = 11.0;
    const topR = 8.55;
    const baseY = 3.05;
    const topY = 12.65;
    const p1 = radialPoint(a, baseR, baseY);
    const p2 = radialPoint(a, topR, topY);

    for (const side of [-1, 1]) {
      const offBase = tangent.clone().multiplyScalar(side * 0.43);
      const offTop = tangent.clone().multiplyScalar(side * 0.25);
      beam(g, p1.clone().add(offBase), p2.clone().add(offTop), 0.15, MAT.steel, 7);
      beam(g, p1.clone().add(offBase).add(V3(0, 0.2, 0)), p2.clone().add(offTop).add(V3(0, -0.1, 0)), 0.055, MAT.hullLight, 5);
    }

    for (const t of [0.29, 0.61]) {
      const a1 = p1.clone().lerp(p2, t).add(tangent.clone().multiplyScalar(0.42));
      const a2 = p1.clone().lerp(p2, t).add(tangent.clone().multiplyScalar(-0.42));
      const b1 = p1.clone().lerp(p2, t + 0.12).add(tangent.clone().multiplyScalar(0.26));
      const b2 = p1.clone().lerp(p2, t + 0.12).add(tangent.clone().multiplyScalar(-0.26));
      beam(g, a1, b2, 0.045, MAT.hullDark, 5);
      beam(g, a2, b1, 0.045, MAT.hullDark, 5);
    }

    const footA = p1.clone().add(tangent.clone().multiplyScalar(0.45));
    const footB = p1.clone().add(tangent.clone().multiplyScalar(-0.45));
    beam(g, footA.clone().add(V3(0, -0.6, 0)), footB.clone().add(V3(0, -0.6, 0)), 0.1, MAT.hullMid, 5);
    box(g, 1.55, 0.4, 1.6, MAT.hull, p1.x, 2.82, p1.z, radialRotation(a));

    if (i % 2 === 0) {
      const glowA = p1.clone().lerp(p2, 0.18);
      const glowB = p1.clone().lerp(p2, 0.82);
      beam(g, glowA, glowB, 0.024, MAT.glowSoft, 5);
    }
  }

  for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
    buildMast(g, i / 4 * TAU + TAU / 8, i);
  }

  finalizeModule('truss');
}

function buildCooling() {
  const inst = createModule('cooling');
  const g = inst.group;
  const count = 10;

  for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
    const a = i / count * TAU + 0.2;
    const pts = [
      radialPoint(a, 10.05, 2.85),
      radialPoint(a, 9.98, 5.7),
      radialPoint(a, 9.4, 10.2),
      radialPoint(a, 8.7, 14.2),
      radialPoint(a, 7.48, 18.35)
    ];
    const cx = pts.reduce((s, p) => s + p.x, 0) / pts.length;
    const cz = pts.reduce((s, p) => s + p.z, 0) / pts.length;
    const grp = new THREE.Group();
    grp.position.set(cx, 0, cz);
    g.add(grp);

    const local = pts.map((p) => V3(p.x - cx, p.y, p.z - cz));
    const curve = new THREE.CatmullRomCurve3(local, false, 'catmullrom', 0.4);
    const tube = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.TubeGeometry(curve, 36, 0.27, 7, false), MAT.pipe);
    grp.add(tube);

    for (const t of [0.18, 0.48, 0.79]) {
      const p = curve.getPointAt(t);
      const tangent = curve.getTangentAt(t).normalize();
      const collar = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.CylinderGeometry(0.43, 0.43, 0.52, 10), MAT.hullLight);
      collar.position.copy(p);
      collar.quaternion.setFromUnitVectors(V3(0, 1, 0), tangent);
      grp.add(collar);
    }

    const glowP = curve.getPointAt(0.6);
    const glowT = curve.getTangentAt(0.6).normalize();
    const glowRing = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.TorusGeometry(0.34, 0.032, 6, 18), MAT.glow);
    glowRing.position.copy(glowP);
    glowRing.quaternion.setFromUnitVectors(V3(0, 0, 1), glowT);

    const end = curve.getPointAt(1);
    const joint = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.CylinderGeometry(0.46, 0.5, 0.7, 10), MAT.hullMid);
    joint.position.copy(end);
    grp.add(joint);

    const base = curve.getPointAt(0);
    const baseJoint = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.BoxGeometry(0.68, 0.38, 0.68), MAT.hullDark);
    baseJoint.position.copy(base);
    baseJoint.position.y += 0.2;
    grp.add(baseJoint);
  }

  for (let i = 0; i < 6; i++) {
    const a = i / 6 * TAU + 0.5;
    beam(g, radialPoint(a, 10.55, 3.0), radialPoint(a, 10.42, 8.3), 0.055, MAT.pipe, 5);
    box(g, 0.18, 0.18, 0.18, MAT.glowSoft, Math.cos(a) * 10.46, 8.45, Math.sin(a) * 10.46, radialRotation(a));
  }

  torus(g, 10.1, 0.2, MAT.hullDark, 0, 3.0, 0);
  torus(g, 7.5, 0.19, MAT.hullMid, 0, 18.4, 0);
  torus(g, 10.08, 0.035, MAT.glowSoft, 0, 5.7, 0);

  for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
    const a = i / count * TAU + 0.2;

function updateSteam(dt) {
  for (let i = 0; i < steamSprites.length; i++) {
    const sprite = steamSprites[i];
    const m = steamMeta[i];
    m.rise += dt * m.speed;
    const t = (m.rise % 10) / 10;
    const drift = Math.sin(time * 0.35 + m.phase) * (0.6 + t * 2.6);
    sprite.position.set(Math.cos(m.a) * (m.r + drift), 1.2 + t * 14, Math.sin(m.a) * (m.r + drift));
    const sc = 4.5 + t * 11;
    sprite.scale.set(sc, sc * 1.18, 1);
    sprite.material.opacity = Math.sin(t * Math.PI) * 0.055;
  }
}

function toggleModule(id, force) {
  const inst = modules.get(id);

  inst.target = next;
  inst.delay = 0;
  refreshListStates();

  showToast(next ? `${inst.meta.name} · 展开` : `${inst.meta.name} · 收回`);
}

function setAllModules(value) {
  MODULE_META.forEach((meta, index) => {
    const inst = modules.get(meta.id);
    const order = value === 1 ? index : MODULE_META.length - 1 - index;
    inst.target = value;
    inst.delay = order * 0.055;
  });
  refreshListStates();
  if (selectedId) renderInspector(selectedId);
  else renderOverview();
}

function focusModule(id) {
  const inst = modules.get(id);
  if (!inst) return;
  const box = new THREE.Box3();
  inst.meshes.forEach((mesh) => {
    mesh.updateWorldMatrix(true, false);
    if (mesh.geometry) {
      mesh.geometry.computeBoundingBox();
      const b = mesh.geometry.boundingBox.clone().applyMatrix4(mesh.matrixWorld);
      box.union(b);
    }
  });
  if (box.isEmpty()) return;
  const center = box.getCenter(V3());
  const size = box.getSize(V3());
  const dist = Math.max(size.length() * 1.22, 18);
  const dir = V3().subVectors(camera.position, controls.target).normalize();
  if (dir.lengthSq() < 0.001) dir.copy(DEFAULT_CAM).normalize();
  const pos = center.clone().add(dir.multiplyScalar(dist));
  flyCameraTo(pos, center, 1.0);
}

function flyCameraTo(position, target, duration = 1.1) {
  cameraTween = {
    fromPos: camera.position.clone(),
    toPos: position.clone(),
    fromTarget: controls.target.clone(),
    toTarget: target.clone(),
    start: performance.now(),
    duration: Math.max(0.2, duration)
  };
  controls.enabled = false;
}

function resetView() {

function cancelIgnitionPending() {
  if (igniteTimer) {

function requestIgnition() {
  if (ignitionTarget > 0.5 || ignitionPending) return;
  const openCount = openModuleCount();
  if (openCount > 0) {
    ignitionPending = true;
    setMode('igniting');
    setAllModules(0);
    showToast('机构复位中 · 点火序列排队');
    refreshControls();
  } else {
    actuallyIgnite();
  }
}

function modulesRetracted() {
  let done = true;
  modules.forEach((inst) => {
    if (inst.delay > 0 || inst.progress > 0.012) done = false;
  });
  return done;
}

function actuallyIgnite() {
  if (ignitionTarget > 0.5) return;
  ignitionTarget = 1;
  ignitionRamp = { start: performance.now(), from: ignition, duration: 2.6 };
  setMode('igniting');
  ignitionFlashEl.classList.add('on');

function shutdownEngine() {
  if (ignitionTarget < 0.5 && !ignitionPending && ignition < 0.02) return;
  cancelIgnitionPending();
  ignitionTarget = 0;
  ignitionRamp = { start: performance.now(), from: ignition, duration: 2.2 };

function layoutLabelColumn(items, lh) {
  if (!items.length) return;
  const boxH = 52;
  items.sort((a, b) => a.y - b.y);
  const span = labelBounds.bottom - labelBounds.top;
  let cursor = labelBounds.top;
  items.forEach((item) => {
    item.y = Math.max(item.y, cursor);
    cursor = item.y + lh + 7;
  });
  const overflow = cursor - 7 - labelBounds.bottom;
  if (overflow > 0) {
    // Too many tags for the available height: redistribute them evenly so
    // adjacent cards never land on the same row (which caused overlap).
    const step = clamp((span - boxH) / Math.max(1, items.length - 1), 46, lh + 7);
    items.forEach((item, index) => { item.y = labelBounds.top + index * step; });
    return;
  }
  const topOverflow = labelBounds.top - items[0].y;
  if (topOverflow > 0) items.forEach((item) => { item.y += topOverflow; });
  items.forEach((item) => {
    item.y = clamp(item.y, labelBounds.top, labelBounds.bottom - boxH);
  });
}

function updateLabels() {
  const W = window.innerWidth;
  const H = window.innerHeight;
  const mw = window.innerWidth <= 820 ? 132 : labelWidth;
  const lh = 52;
  const items = [];
  const camDist = camera.position.distanceTo(controls.target);
  const suppress = ignitionPending || runMode !== 'standby' || camDist > 190;
  const hide = (el, path, circle) => {
    if (el) el.classList.remove('show');
    if (path) path.style.opacity = '0';
    if (circle) circle.style.opacity = '0';
  };

  MODULE_META.forEach((meta, index) => {
    const inst = modules.get(meta.id);
    const el = labelEls.get(meta.id);
    const path = labelPaths.get(meta.id);
    const circle = labelCircles.get(meta.id);
    if (!inst || !el || !path || !circle) return;
    const show = !suppress && (selectedId === meta.id || Math.max(inst.progress, inst.target) > 0.14);
    if (!show) {
      hide(el, path, circle);
      return;
    }
    inst.anchor.getWorldPosition(tmpVec);
    tmpVec.project(camera);
    if (tmpVec.z > 1 || tmpVec.z < -1) {
      hide(el, path, circle);
      return;
    }
    const sx = (tmpVec.x * 0.5 + 0.5) * W;
    const sy = (-tmpVec.y * 0.5 + 0.5) * H;
    if (sx < -220 || sx > W + 220 || sy < -180 || sy > H + 180 || labelBounds.right - labelBounds.left < mw + 16) {
      hide(el, path, circle);
      return;
    }

    let side = sx < W * 0.5 ? -1 : 1;
    if (Math.abs(sx - W * 0.5) < 90) side = index % 2 === 0 ? -1 : 1;
    if (side === -1 && sx - mw - 36 < labelBounds.left) side = 1;
    if (side === 1 && sx + mw + 36 > labelBounds.right) side = -1;

    let lx = side === -1 ? sx - 36 - mw : sx + 36;
    lx = clamp(lx, labelBounds.left, labelBounds.right - mw);
    let ly = sy - 36;
    ly = clamp(ly, labelBounds.top, labelBounds.bottom - lh);

    items.push({ meta, inst, el, path, circle, sx, sy, side, x: lx, y: ly, h: lh, w: mw });
  });

  const leftItems = items.filter((item) => item.side === -1);
  const rightItems = items.filter((item) => item.side === 1);
  layoutLabelColumn(leftItems, lh);
  layoutLabelColumn(rightItems, lh);

  items.forEach((item) => {
    const { el, path, circle, sx, sy, side, x, y, w } = item;
    el.style.width = w + 'px';
    el.style.left = x.toFixed(1) + 'px';
    el.style.top = y.toFixed(1) + 'px';
    el.classList.add('show');

    const attachX = side === -1 ? x + w : x;
    const attachY = y + 21;
    const midX = sx + side * 18;
    path.setAttribute('d', `M ${sx.toFixed(1)} ${sy.toFixed(1)} L ${midX.toFixed(1)} ${sy.toFixed(1)} L ${attachX.toFixed(1)} ${attachY.toFixed(1)}`);
    path.style.opacity = '0.9';
    circle.setAttribute('cx', sx.toFixed(1));
    circle.setAttribute('cy', sy.toFixed(1));
    circle.style.opacity = '0.95';
  });
}

function setPointerFromEvent(event) {
  lastPointer.x = event.clientX;
  lastPointer.y = event.clientY;
  pointerNdc.x = (event.clientX / window.innerWidth) * 2 - 1;
  pointerNdc.y = -(event.clientY / window.innerHeight) * 2 + 1;
}

function raycastModules(event) {
  setPointerFromEvent(event);
  raycaster.setFromCamera(pointerNdc, camera);
  const hits = raycaster.intersectObjects(interactiveMeshes, false);
  return hits;
}

canvas.addEventListener('pointermove', (event) => {
  setPointerFromEvent(event);
  pointerInside = true;
  hoverDirty = true;
});

canvas.addEventListener('pointerleave', () => {
  pointerInside = false;
  canvas.style.cursor = 'grab';
  hoverChipEl.classList.remove('show');
});

canvas.addEventListener('pointerdown', (event) => {
  pointerDown = true;
  pointerDownAt = performance.now();
  pointerDownPos.x = event.clientX;
  pointerDownPos.y = event.clientY;
  hoverChipEl.classList.remove('show');
  setPointerFromEvent(event);
});

canvas.addEventListener('pointerup', (event) => {
  if (!pointerDown) return;
  pointerDown = false;
  const moved = Math.hypot(event.clientX - pointerDownPos.x, event.clientY - pointerDownPos.y);
  const elapsed = performance.now() - pointerDownAt;
  if (moved > 7 || elapsed > 800) return;

  if (window.innerWidth <= 820) {
    leftPanelEl.classList.remove('mobile-open');
    rightPanelEl.classList.remove('mobile-open');
    updateLabelBounds();
  }

  const hits = raycastModules(event);
  if (hits.length) {
    const hit = hits[0].object;
    let node = hit;
    while (node && !node.userData.moduleId) node = node.parent;
    const id = node && node.userData.moduleId;
    if (!id) return;
    if (selectedId === id) {
      toggleModule(id);
    } else {
      selectModule(id, { toggle: true });
    }
  } else {
    selectModule(null);
  }
});

  rightPanelEl.classList.remove('mobile-open');
  updateLabelBounds();
});
$('#toggleRight').addEventListener('click', () => {
  rightPanelEl.classList.toggle('mobile-open');
  leftPanelEl.classList.remove('mobile-open');
  updateLabelBounds();
});

window.addEventListener('resize', () => {
  camera.aspect = window.innerWidth / window.innerHeight;
  camera.updateProjectionMatrix();
  renderer.setPixelRatio(Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio || 1, 2));
  renderer.setSize(window.innerWidth, window.innerHeight, false);
  composer.setPixelRatio(Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio || 1, 2));
  composer.setSize(window.innerWidth, window.innerHeight);
  updateLabelBounds();
});

/* ============================================================
   animation
   ============================================================ */

const clock = new THREE.Clock();

function updateModuleTransforms(dt) {
  modules.forEach((inst) => {
    if (inst.delay > 0) {
      inst.delay = Math.max(0, inst.delay - dt);
    } else {
      const lambda = inst.target > inst.progress ? 4.1 : 5.4;
      inst.progress = damp(inst.progress, inst.target, lambda, dt);
      if (Math.abs(inst.progress - inst.target) < 0.0015) inst.progress = inst.target;
    }

    const p = inst.progress;
    const cfg = inst.meta.explode;
    inst.group.position.y = cfg.lift * p;
    const scale = 1 + (cfg.spread - 1) * p;
    inst.group.scale.set(scale, 1, scale);

    inst.parts.forEach((part) => {
      const base = part.userData.basePos;
      if (!base) return;
      part.position.copy(base);
      const radial = part.userData.radialDir;
      if (radial) part.position.addScaledVector(radial, cfg.radial * p);
    });
  });
}

function updateSpinAndAmbient(dt) {
  spinObjects.forEach((item) => {
    if (item.axis === 'y') item.obj.rotation.y += item.speed * dt * (1 + ignition * 0.75);
    else if (item.axis === 'x') item.obj.rotation.x += item.speed * dt;
  });

  beaconMaterial.emissiveIntensity = 1.35 + Math.sin(time * 3.1) * 0.8 + ignition * 0.8;

  const core = modules.get('core');
  if (core && core.coreParticles) {
    const cp = core.coreParticles;
    for (let i = 0; i < cp.meta.length; i++) {
      const m = cp.meta[i];
      m.a += m.speed * dt * (0.45 + ignition * 2.2);
      const y = m.y + Math.sin(time * 0.9 + i) * 0.22;
      cp.positions[i * 3] = Math.cos(m.a) * m.r;
      cp.positions[i * 3 + 1] = y;
      cp.positions[i * 3 + 2] = Math.sin(m.a) * m.r;
    }
    cp.points.geometry.attributes.position.needsUpdate = true;
    cp.points.material.opacity = 0.48 + ignition * 0.35;
  }

  for (let i = 0; i < dustMeta.length; i++) {
    const m = dustMeta[i];
    m.y += m.speed * dt;
    m.a += m.drift * dt;
    if (m.y > 38) m.y = 0;
    dustPositions[i * 3] = Math.cos(m.a) * m.r;
    dustPositions[i * 3 + 1] = m.y;
    dustPositions[i * 3 + 2] = Math.sin(m.a) * m.r;
  }
  dustGeo.attributes.position.needsUpdate = true;
}

function updateIgnition(dt) {
  const prev = ignition;
  const elapsed = Math.max(0, (performance.now() - ignitionRamp.start) / 1000);
  const ramp = clamp(elapsed / ignitionRamp.duration, 0, 1);
  const eased = ignitionTarget >= ignitionRamp.from
    ? 1 - Math.pow(1 - ramp, 3)
    : easeInOutCubic(ramp);
  ignition = ignitionRamp.from + (ignitionTarget - ignitionRamp.from) * eased;
  if (ramp >= 1) ignition = ignitionTarget;

  if (runMode === 'igniting' && ignition > 0.94) {
    setMode('online');
    showToast('点火成功 · 聚变反应自持');
  }
  if (runMode === 'cooldown' && ignition < 0.035) {
    setMode('standby');
  }

  const beamStrength = easeInOutCubic(clamp((ignition - 0.012) / 0.62, 0, 1));

  coreUniforms.uTime.value = time;
  coreUniforms.uPower.value = ignition;
  beamUniforms.uTime.value = time;
  beamUniforms.uOpacity.value = beamStrength * (0.66 + Math.sin(time * 23.0) * 0.05);
  cinemaPass.uniforms.uTime.value = time;
  cinemaPass.uniforms.uHeat.value = ignition;
  beamCloudGlow.material.opacity = 0.012 + ignition * 0.028;

  coreLight.intensity = 3.6 + ignition * 10;
  emitterLight.intensity = ignition * 4.5;
  beamLight.intensity = beamStrength * 11;
  shaftMaterial.opacity = 0.011 + ignition * 0.011;

  const core = modules.get('core');
  if (core && core.coreGlowSprite) {
    core.coreGlowSprite.material.opacity = 0.3 + ignition * 0.18;
    const s = 8.2 + ignition * 1.8 + Math.sin(time * 2.3) * 0.16;
    core.coreGlowSprite.scale.set(s, s * 1.6, 1);
  }

  ignitionGlowMaterials.forEach((mat, index) => {
    if (mat.userData.baseGlow === undefined) mat.userData.baseGlow = mat.emissiveIntensity;
    mat.emissiveIntensity = mat.userData.baseGlow + ignition * (1.2 + (index % 3) * 0.22) + Math.sin(time * 4 + index) * ignition * 0.15;
  });

  const crystal = modules.get('ignition').crystal;
  if (crystal) {
    const cs = 1 + ignition * 0.26 + Math.sin(time * 5.2) * 0.035;
    crystal.scale.setScalar(cs);
  }

  if (beamFX) {
    beamFX.group.visible = beamStrength > 0.002;
    beamFX.group.scale.y = Math.max(0.001, beamStrength);
    beamFX.group.scale.x = 1;
    beamFX.group.scale.z = 1;
    beamFX.innerMaterial.opacity = beamStrength * 0.32;
    beamFX.haloMaterial.opacity = beamStrength * 0.05;
    beamFX.baseGlow.material.opacity = beamStrength * 0.36;
    const bg = 9 + ignition * 2.2 + Math.sin(time * 5) * 0.35;
    beamFX.baseGlow.scale.set(bg, bg, 1);
    beamFX.particles.visible = beamStrength > 0.005;
    beamFX.particleMaterial.opacity = beamStrength * 0.65;

    beamFX.rings.forEach((ring, i) => {
      const t = ((time * 0.19 + ring.offset) % 1);
      ring.mesh.position.y = t * 39;
      const sc = 0.72 + t * 1.9;
      ring.mesh.scale.set(sc, sc, 1);
      ring.mat.opacity = beamStrength * (1 - t) * 0.28;
    });

    const pos = beamFX.particlePositions;
    const meta = beamFX.particleMeta;
    for (let i = 0; i < meta.length; i++) {
      const p = meta[i];
      p.y += p.speed * dt * (0.35 + ignition * 1.9);
      p.angle += p.spin * dt;
      if (p.y > 39) {
        p.y = Math.random() * 2;
        p.angle = Math.random() * TAU;
        p.radius = 0.25 + Math.pow(Math.random(), 0.55) * 2.1;
      }
      const r = p.radius * (1 + p.y * 0.014);
      pos[i * 3] = Math.cos(p.angle) * r;
      pos[i * 3 + 1] = p.y;
      pos[i * 3 + 2] = Math.sin(p.angle) * r;
    }
    beamFX.particleGeometry.attributes.position.needsUpdate = true;
  }

  if (shockRing) {
    const st = (time * 0.34) % 1;
    const sr = 7 + st * 78;
    shockRing.mesh.scale.set(sr, sr, 1);
    shockRing.mat.opacity = ignition > 0.04 ? (1 - st) * (1 - st) * ignition * 0.36 : 0;
    shockRing.mesh.visible = ignition > 0.03;
  }

  bloomPass.strength = 0.5 + ignition * 0.42;
  bloomPass.radius = 0.62 + ignition * 0.08;
  bloomPass.threshold = 0.86 - ignition * 0.02;
  renderer.toneMappingExposure = 1.06 + ignition * 0.02;

  if (prev < 0.04 && ignition >= 0.04) ignitionFlashEl.classList.remove('on');
}

function updateTelemetry(dt) {
  telemetryTimer += dt;
  if (telemetryTimer < 0.1) return;
  telemetryTimer = 0;
  metricOutputEl.textContent = (ignition * 100).toFixed(1) + ' %';
  metricOutputEl.classList.toggle('hot', ignition > 0.02);
  metricFieldEl.textContent = (18.7 + ignition * 3.7).toFixed(1) + ' T';
  metricFieldEl.classList.toggle('hot', ignition > 0.02);
  if (liveThrustEl) {
    liveThrustEl.textContent = (ignition * 15000).toFixed(ignition > 0.1 ? 0 : 1) + ' GN';
    liveThrustEl.classList.toggle('hot', ignition > 0.02);
  }
  if (liveTempEl) {
    liveTempEl.textContent = ignition > 0.02 ? (ignition * 1.2).toFixed(2) + ' × 10⁸ K' : '84 K';
    liveTempEl.classList.toggle('hot', ignition > 0.02);
  }
  if (liveFuelEl) liveFuelEl.textContent = (92.4 - ignition * 0.8).toFixed(1) + ' %';
  if (liveWarnEl) {
    const warn = runMode === 'igniting' ? 'IGNITION' : runMode === 'online' ? 'NOMINAL' : runMode === 'cooldown' ? 'COOLDOWN' : 'STANDBY';
    liveWarnEl.textContent = warn;
    liveWarnEl.classList.toggle('warn', runMode === 'cooldown');
    liveWarnEl.classList.toggle('hot', runMode === 'igniting' || runMode === 'online');
  }
  if (selectedId === 'core') {
    const coreStateEl = inspectorEl.querySelector('[data-live="core-state"]');
    if (coreStateEl) {
      coreStateEl.textContent = runMode === 'online' ? '运行中' : runMode === 'igniting' ? '点火中' : runMode === 'cooldown' ? '冷却中' : '待机';
    }
  }
}

function updateCameraTween() {
  if (!cameraTween) return;
  const elapsed = (performance.now() - cameraTween.start) / 1000;
  const raw = clamp(elapsed / cameraTween.duration, 0, 1);
  const e = easeInOutCubic(raw);
  camera.position.lerpVectors(cameraTween.fromPos, cameraTween.toPos, e);
  controls.target.lerpVectors(cameraTween.fromTarget, cameraTween.toTarget, e);
  controls.update();
  if (raw >= 1) {
    cameraTween = null;
    controls.enabled = true;
  }
}

function doHoverCheck() {
  if (!hoverDirty || pointerDown || !pointerInside) return;
  hoverDirty = false;
  raycaster.setFromCamera(
    new THREE.Vector2(
      (lastPointer.x / window.innerWidth) * 2 - 1,
      -(lastPointer.y / window.innerHeight) * 2 + 1
    ),
    camera
  );
  const hits = raycaster.intersectObjects(interactiveMeshes, false);
  canvas.style.cursor = hits.length ? 'pointer' : 'grab';

  if (!hits.length || window.innerWidth <= 820) {
    hoverChipEl.classList.remove('show');
    return;
  }
  let node = hits[0].object;
  while (node && !node.userData.moduleId) node = node.parent;
  const id = node && node.userData.moduleId;
  const meta = id ? MODULE_META.find((m) => m.id === id) : null;
  if (!meta) {
    hoverChipEl.classList.remove('show');
    return;
  }
  hoverChipEl.innerHTML = `<span class="hc-code">${meta.code}</span><span>${meta.name}</span><span class="hc-en">${meta.en}</span>`;
  const w = hoverChipEl.offsetWidth;
  const h = hoverChipEl.offsetHeight;
  let x = lastPointer.x + 18;
  let y = lastPointer.y + 17;
  if (x + w > window.innerWidth - 12) x = lastPointer.x - w - 18;
  if (y + h > window.innerHeight - 12) y = lastPointer.y - h - 17;
  hoverChipEl.style.left = x.toFixed(1) + 'px';
  hoverChipEl.style.top = y.toFixed(1) + 'px';
  hoverChipEl.classList.add('show');
}

function animate() {
  const dt = Math.min(clock.getDelta(), 0.05);
  time += dt;

  camera.position.sub(shakeOffset);
  shakeOffset.set(0, 0, 0);
  updateCameraTween();
  if (!cameraTween) controls.update();

  const shakeAmp = ignition > 0.02 ? (runMode === 'igniting' ? 0.14 : 0.034) * ignition : 0;
  if (shakeAmp > 0.002) {
    shakeOffset.set((Math.random() - 0.5) * shakeAmp, (Math.random() - 0.5) * shakeAmp, (Math.random() - 0.5) * shakeAmp);
    camera.position.add(shakeOffset);
  }

  updateModuleTransforms(dt);
  if (ignitionPending && modulesRetracted()) {
    if (igniteTimer) { clearTimeout(igniteTimer); igniteTimer = null; }
    ignitionPending = false;
    actuallyIgnite();
  }
  updateSpinAndAmbient(dt);
  updateBackdrop(dt);
  updateSteam(dt);
  updateScaleAnchors(dt);
  updateIgnition(dt);
  updateScaleHud(dt);
  updateTelemetry(dt);
  updateLabels();
  doHoverCheck();

  groundUniforms.uTime.value = time;
  composer.render();
}

   ============================================================ */

async function init() {
  await bootStep(16, '加载渲染内核 / WebGL 2 ...', 80);
  await bootStep(38, '重建承力结构 / 14 GROUPS · 1,024 NODES ...', 90);
  await bootStep(61, '校准磁约束场 / 22.4 TESLA ...', 90);
  await bootStep(79, '铺设冷却回路 / 12 LOOPS ...', 80);
  await bootStep(92, '连接遥测链路 / UPLINK 98.4% ...', 80);

  buildPartList();
  buildLabels();
  renderOverview();
  refreshListStates();
  updateLabelBounds();
  refreshControls();

  window.__PE_DEBUG = { scene, camera, controls, composer, modules, LAYER_INFO, cameraTween: () => cameraTween, ignition: () => ignition, viewMode: () => viewMode, layer: () => currentLayer };

  renderer.compile(scene, camera);
  renderer.setAnimationLoop(animate);

  await bootStep(100, 'SYSTEM READY / 发动机控制台上线', 150);
  window.__engineReady = true;
  setTimeout(() => bootEl.classList.add('hidden'), 420);
}

init();
